purpose: Teach: 仏壇/クローズアップ/パロディ/編曲/生態学/魔法使い/戯曲/ナース

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがお家の仏壇を毎日整えてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother takes care of the family altar every single day.
lines.style: Gentle, informative tone. Speaking as if sharing something meaningful but understated. Slight warm pause after the first name, creating a moment of connection before the observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、テレビ番組でクローズアップされたお話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw a story about it on TV once — they talked about it in detail.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick tempo, slightly breathless with the excitement of sharing something he's learned. The 'once' lands with a small note of pride in having remembered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが歌のパロディを歌ってらっしゃるわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father sings a funny parody version of that song sometimes.
lines.style: Warm amusement underneath. Slight conspiratorial tone — sharing a gentle observation about his father. Measured pace, affectionate without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノの先生に編曲教えてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, my piano teacher actually showed me how to arrange music like that.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the voice. Sits up a little straighter in the delivery. Not boasting — genuinely pleased to be learning something. Slight emphasis on 'actually,' showing he's been thinking about this.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが生態学のお仕事してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father does ecology research — did you know that?
lines.style: Reflective, gentle curiosity in the question. Pacing is unhurried. A moment of quiet wondering before the question — as if she's thinking aloud about what Sho might understand about his father's world.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、魔法使いみたいになりたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to be like a magician someday — making things change and surprise people.
lines.style: Dreamy, wistful quality. Slightly slower pace, reaching a little higher on the word 'magician.' Open and vulnerable in the way only a six-year-old can be when sharing what he truly wants.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが戯曲を観に行きましょうって
lines.en: Sho, your father asked if you'd like to go see a play with him.
lines.style: Warm invitation in the voice. Gentle, inviting tone — this is good news being delivered softly. A slight lift at the end, as if she's offering him something special without making it a big deal.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんがナースだったってお話してくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma told me she used to be a nurse — that's so cool.
lines.style: Warm wonder and admiration. Slightly faster pace from genuine excitement. The 'that's so cool' lands with genuine delight — he's only just learning this and it changes how he sees his grandmother.
